notes: Synth Deck in the MIDI Hub (Keys › MIDI): a Now bar with your current sound, Buttons for scenes, arpeggiator, Motion Sequencer, Part mute and switches, extra knob pages, a Sounds library you build and load with one tap (plus the MODX factory names, bank browser and Read name from synth), a Scope that draws what the arpeggiator and sequencer send against the clock, and a Map where every number is editable and MIDI-learnable. Helix Stadium page (Guitar › Helix) merged. Earlier 1.0.0 notes — Guided performance: Wait for Me and Play at Tempo with piano-roll targets, virtual/MIDI or monophonic audio input, chords, loops and accuracy reports. One clef menu controls comprehensive Scale Lock, optional LUMI Display and shared Intervals/Note Names colors. Per-instrument progress adds measured engagement, daily goals, configurable consistency XP/decay, charts and export. Audio chords and hardware response remain explicitly unverified/unsupported as documented. Native APK channel remains unchanged.
